verdict.rationale: pnpm documents installing and pinning Node.js per project with no nvm or shell hooks. The runtime is declared via `devEngines.runtime` in the checked-in package.json, and the `packageManager`/`devEngines.packageManager` fields make pnpm switch to the pinned pnpm version automatically. The GitHub README also states it works as a Node.js version manager. missing for 10: support for runtimes or tools beyond Node.js and pnpm itself, detailed docs on the config syntax and switching behavior, independent hands-on corroboration.
